source: Similarity geometry usually needs a suitable readout and training objective. “Cosine and dot product are the same.” They agree on unit-normalized vectors, not arbitrary vectors. “More dimensions always improve retrieval.” Dimension trades capacity against storage/compute and depends on training. “You can compare embeddings from different models if dimensions match.”
zh: 相似几何通常需要合适的读出和训练目标。 “余弦和点积是相同的。”他们同意单位归一化向量，而不是任意向量。 “更多维度总是可以提高检索效率。” Dimension 将容量与存储/计算进行交换，并且取决于培训。 “如果尺寸匹配，您可以比较不同模型的嵌入。”
